company.name: Toga Food SA
company.distributes: Branded European confectionery and snacks, spreads, gourmet products, pasta, oils and seasonings.
company.channels_supplied: Swiss food retail trade, from very small customers (24 hour delivery from 15 cartons) to full truckloads; named chains not verified.
what_they_do_well: Holds IFS Logistic and IFS Broker certification with a 5,000 to 6,000 pallet warehouse handling about 5,500 tonnes a year.
company.fit_rationale: Acts as the full Swiss import, sales and marketing arm for European brand manufacturers, which matches how an exporter like B Healthy would enter. It scouts new brands at ISM and Anuga, where Diablo exhibits its category. National delivery covers Zurich.
